scope: One pinned calculator, one cooperative local worker and six focused cases. Approval uses disclosed same-world source-segmented evidence, not a clean 144-placement run of the final release.

execution_composition.interpretation: Started with an empty circuit and exactly 144 controlled items. Initial client checkpointed 12 placements; another process reached 137. Thin-reference support then stopped safely. Actual native events and placement receipts establish 137; the stale saved progress hint was 136 and was not treated as authority.

Same saved world, deployment and stock baseline. Four bricks, two redstone dust and one torch were consumed in seven native placements. The worker completed correctly; an immediate inspection request hit HTTP 429, so the wrapper remains failed.

The completed-world baseline was transparently composed from retained final block/checkpoint/receipt evidence, then checked against a fresh live observation. No restoration or stock injection occurred. The worker consumed nothing and the protected checker passed all 16 rows at revision 144.

case_judgments.judgment: All 144 blueprint positions and static orientations are physically observed. Native accepted events are unique, withdrawal/placement receipts conserve the exact material bill, and the real 16-row checker passes. Evidence is the disclosed 137 + 7 + 0 composition.

The 12-placement process restart, later 137-placement baseline, seven-item continuation and completed-world restart use the same durable job. Actual blocks and inventories are rechecked; prior placement receipts are not executed twice.

Actual shortage and occupied-target runs each wait with zero placements and no invented stock. Their old source snapshots remain retained. Subsequent adapter/plugin changes concern native placement and are unreachable before these waits; observation, stock, checkpoint and refusal paths are unchanged.

An actual glass obstruction at the declared crossing produces a bounded navigation refusal while all 144 stock items, structure, inventories and revision remain unchanged. Later changes affect native placement, not the executed zero-placement navigation path.

Unsupported orientation and blueprint hash are refused before retrieval or placement in the initial live fixture. The final ConstructionWorker constructor and manifest-validation code are byte-identical; no rotated physical build is claimed.

Actual guards cover wrong session, unauthorized role, stale revision, expiry and inspection lock. Expired PLACE uses a real borrowed/equipped item and returns it with exact final no-effects. Fresh current-source P1 native permissions and the denied unsneaked thin-reference operation supplement the unchanged prepare-time paths.

release_binding.only_post_run_snapshot_difference: tests/construction/continue.py changes one console sentence from original137-placement world to retained construction world. Exact comparison confirms no behavioral change.
release_binding.prior_source_reuse: Original solid-reference behavior retains priority; new thin-reference/sneak branches were not executed by the prior 137 successful placements or the zero-placement shortage, occupied and blocked scenarios. Continuation fixture mode is observation-only and forbids bootstrap on the preserved world.

defect_review.judgment: Startup/schema/admission and harness errors are closed by later actual startup and execution. Navigation/descent/arrival issues are closed by the 50-check live access run and completed construction. Orientation and thin-reference issues are closed by actual final block states and the 16-row inspection. The inspection-rate error is closed by the zero-placement inspection segment. Original failed reports remain retained; development notes describe historical pending states, not current open defects.

deferred_requirements: All fourteen original P2 families remain under P9-059 through P9-072. This local approval does not pass their unrun fault matrices or distributed lease requirement.
limitations: Historical Paper 1.21.11 build 132 remains unsupported for production.
Offline identities and the 198 glass blocks plus nine bottom slabs are disclosed operator fixtures.
No independently controlled human, authenticated-account, live 0G/Arkiv, token-platform, funded-chain, wallet-signature or settlement approval is established.
No distributed task lease is proved; the worker is limited to cooperative exclusion on one host.
A clean build of all 144 placements using only the final release was not executed.
Scripted domain/adapter checks and constructor checks are distinguished from actual world evidence.
This review introduces no signature, funding, purchase, requester acceptance or readiness authority for the worker.
Root must bind evidence/P2.json and execute the gate before reporting gate readiness.
